items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: He was a terrific breathing man. He taught using the diaphragm to accentuate the notes

ctx.x: And you studied trombone with him?

Yes, I took a few lessons with him. Mostly on breathing and things like that, you know. And then there was Larry -- Larry -- oh, I forget his last name too. He was a terrific breathing man. He taught using the diaphragm to accentuate the notes, punch the notes and give power to the notes.
